data.name: Battlespace Command
data.detailed_description:
Full-Spectrum Combined Arms Warfare

From squads on the ground to long-range strike aircraft, Battlespace Command puts you in control of modern warfare across every domain. Plan, coordinate, and execute operations where infantry, armor, artillery, air power, drones, warships, and support assets all work together - or fail together.

See the Battle from Every Angle

Switch seamlessly between a tactical command map and a fully simulated 3D battlefield. Issue orders, define the Rules of Engagement, and watch your decisions unfold in real time. 

The Modern Battlespace at Real-World Scale

Fight across massive maps spanning thousands of kilometers. Every unit exists on the battlefield, every maneuver takes time, and every engagement happens at realistic ranges. 

Dominate the Information Battlefield

Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) platforms, electronic warfare systems, and communication networks define what you can see - and what you can strike. Realistic, physics-based simulation of sensors and signals make these force enablers vital to successful operations. 

A Platform for Modern Warfare

With deep modding support, mission creation, and planned Steam Workshop integration, Battlespace Command is built to grow and expand with new content, new scenarios, and new ways to fight.

FEATURES

  • Command across dual perspectives
    Plan and issue orders from a high-level command map and watch engagements unfold in a fully simulated 3D battlefield.

  • Multi-Domain Operations
    Coordinate infantry, armored units, artillery, drones, helicopters, aircraft, naval forces, and missile systems in a single, unified battlespace.

  • Hundreds of units and weapons
    250+ unit types, including infantry, IFVs, MBTs, UAVs, AEW aircraft, bombers, tankers, carriers, submarines, ballistic missile launchers, and more - each with realistic capabilities and loadouts.

  • Massive real-world maps
    Battlefields of up to 6,250,000 km², generated from real geographic data with destructible environments and urban combat.

  • No abstractions or off-map support
    Every asset exists on the battlefield. Call in artillery, close air support, or missile strikes by commanding the actual units executing them.

  • Advanced simulation of sensors and signals
    Radar systems, jamming, ELINT, sensors, and communication links are modelled in detail.

  • Realistic engagement ranges and pacing.
    Some engagements span a single city block, others span hundreds of kilometres. Positioning, reconnaissance, and timing are critical.

  • Rules of Engagement system
    Define how your units move, select weapons, and engage targets across different domains.

  • Large-scale AI operations
    Fight against an AI capable of planning and executing coordinated attacks across land, air, and sea.

  • 50+ playable nations (and growing)
    Deploy forces from a wide range of modern militaries, each with unique equipment and capabilities.

  • Mission editor and scenario creation
    Design custom operations with full control over units, objectives, and battlefield conditions.

  • Full modding support
    Modify units, maps, nations, and even core simulation parameters.

  • Steam Workshop integration (planned)
    Share and discover community-created missions, units, and scenarios.

data.short_description: Take command of modern warfare across land, air, and sea in a real-time strategy sandbox. Direct every unit, from infantry to aircraft carriers, across vast, real-world scale battlefields where sensors, strategy, and coordination decide the outcome.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 590 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (8 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
